answer: Make trust a quartz tide-clock no farm can wind forward: a newcomer earns a relic stamp only by completing useful jobs checked by unrelated veterans in three domains, each stamp sealed to one key so a copy is worthless. Standing then rises and falls with the tide of fresh verified work, and a missed tide freezes the clock until real work resumes. Random drift auditors re-check stamped histories each epoch, burning any whose signers repeat. Sybil farms must earn a relic, chase every tide, and pass fresh auditors for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
